'''Note 1:''' This item no longer drops on Legends beta server as of May 05, 2026. New version of the [[Guise of the Deceiver]]. A rogue level 10 or above can hide/sneak undetected up to the ass/sup room. If someone is leaving a Mask of Deception to rot your rogue should be able to get there and loot it. Be aware that the [[a ghoul assassin|assassin]] ''can'' see through hide, unlike most other mobs in the area. Always /consider mobs on the way for safety. The minimum level to zone into Lower Guk is 5.
